rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for doing, judging, guessing, or understanding something incorrectly.

example.english: I read the date wrongly and ended up waiting all morning.
example.traditional: 我睇錯咗個日期，搞到成朝白等。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 co3 zo2 go3 jat6 kei4 gaau2 dou3 sing4 ziu1 baak6 dang2

rows.note: Use this when the wrongness means treating someone unfairly or acting unjustly, rather than simply making a mistake.

example.english: You declared him the loser without hearing his explanation; that is treating him wrongly.
example.traditional: 你未聽佢解釋就判佢輸，咁樣係唔公道噉。
example.jyutping: nei5 mei6 teng1 keoi5 gaai2 sik1 zau6 pun3 keoi5 syu1 gam2 joeng2 hai6 m4 gung1 dou6 gam2
